implementation: Returns Manager: one batched Groq vision call reports observations; deterministic checks (identity, completeness, Amazon condition scale) and an ordered rule table decide the disposition. Needs GROQ_API_KEY.
notes: In-process by default. Also serves GET /health and POST /run: uvicorn agents.returns.app:app --port 8104. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY in .env to inspect photos; without it every photographed unit fails open to a pending record.
